label: Conditional rule
description: A rule (RuleSpec, kind conditional) that changes how fields behave when a condition is true: require, show, hide, make read-only, set a value, restrict choice options, show a message, or publish a declared event (emit_event, once each time the condition becomes true; data scope only). With scope data it applies on every write path and drives the field rule hooks in all views; with scope form it only affects one view's presentation.
usage: Express each business policy as one rule with a clear when ("record.category == 'access'").
Use scope data for anything that must hold everywhere; use scope form only for presentation tweaks.
Pair require with show so a newly required field is visible.
constraints: kind is conditional; when is a CEL-subset expression (empty means always); actions has at least one entry.
Action types: require, show, hide, read_only, set_value (value is an expression), restrict_options (options are IDs of the field's choice list), message (tone info, warning, or critical).
Rules run in ascending order, ties by ID; a later set_value overwrites an earlier one. A data rule cannot require and hide the same field under overlapping conditions.
Form-scoped hide and read_only are presentation only and never security controls.
